tools.name: constituency_election_result
tools.description: Latest election result for a UK parliamentary constituency: every candidate with party, votes and vote share, the winner, majority, electorate and turnout, from the UK Parliament Members API. Answers "who won in X and by how much?", including by-elections. Needs a constituency id (get one from const

tools.name: constituency_search
tools.description: Find a UK parliamentary constituency by part of its name and get its id and current MP, from the UK Parliament Members API. This is the lookup step for the election result tools. It searches constituency names only; to go from a postcode to an MP use mp_lookup. (cost: 1 credit)

tools.name: mp_contact_details
tools.description: Official contact details for an MP or peer: parliamentary and constituency office addresses, phone numbers, email, website and listed social media, as published by the UK Parliament Members API. Answers "how do I contact my MP?" for letter writers and constituents with casework. Needs a member id (f

tools.name: member_career_history
tools.description: An MP's or peer's career in Parliament: seats held, party changes, ministerial and shadow posts, other posts and select committee memberships, each with start and end dates, from the UK Parliament Members API. Answers "was X ever a minister?" or "what committees has X sat on?" for journalists, resea

tools.name: member_registered_interests
tools.description: An MP's or peer's declared financial interests by category: outside jobs and earnings, donations, gifts and hospitality, overseas visits, shareholdings and more, with payment details and registration dates, from the UK Parliament Members API. Answers "who pays or funds my MP?" for constituents, jour

tools.name: cabinet_ministers
tools.description: Who holds each UK Cabinet and Cabinet-level post right now, Prime Minister first: the post, department, minister, party, seat and start date, from the UK Parliament Members API. A live answer for "who is the current Chancellor / Health Secretary?" after reshuffles. Optional q filters by post, depart

tools.name: commons_party_seats
tools.description: How many seats each party holds in the House of Commons on a given date, with totals and the number of women MPs, from the UK Parliament Members API state of the parties. Answers "how many MPs does each party have?" after defections and by-elections. Shows the largest party's margin as simple arithm

tools.name: lords_party_composition
tools.description: How many members of the House of Lords each party or group has on a given date, including Crossbench peers, Bishops and non-affiliated members, from the UK Parliament Members API state of the parties. Useful for "how big is the Lords?" and Lords reform questions. Totals may differ slightly from Parl

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "cabinet_ministers" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
